the role of the transcription factor XBP1 in the estrogen-induced proliferation of breast and endmetrial cancer cells.
the role of the estrogen-regulated gene, X-box binding protein (XBP1) in estrogen-induced growth of endometrial cancer and breast cancer cells.
the regulation and functional role of X-box binding Protein-1 in breast and endometrioid endometrial cancer.

XBP1 is a novel estrogen-regulated gene that is involved in estrogen-induced growth of ER positive breast and endmetrial cancer cells.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
estrogen regulates the expression of XBP1, which in turn is required for estrogen-mediated growth of breast and gynecologic cancer cells.
